copy.headline: Game Show Sets Have Found a Second Life on Interactive Live Streams
copy.caption:
The wheel slows beneath a flapper. A camera moves in for the result, lights flash, and the presenter talks the audience through what happens next.

Anyone who grew up watching game shows knows the rhythm. That sequence now plays out on phones and computers, with buttons and text chat alongside the picture.
